parameters.name: GlobalAccelerationInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

parameters.name: IpInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the EIP instance. 

You can call the [DescribeEipAddresses](~~36018~~) operation to query the EIP instance ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance is located. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.
